declared_manifest.scope: Sub-looks formed by time-domain backprojection from CPHD phase history; the vendor SICD is not used.
declared_manifest.why_not_the_sicd: The SICD declares SVA weighting on Grid.Row and Grid.Col without WgtFunct samples. SVA is a nonlinear, pixel-dependent apodization that does not commute with a Doppler sub-band split, so a sub-look masked out of an SVA image is not the image that band would form. Autofocus is declared off and TimeCOAPoly is constant.
advantages_over_block4: slow time of each look is the exact mean TxTime of its pulses
full 22.541 s CPHD dwell instead of the 18.068 s SICD aperture
strictly disjoint looks; no shared aperture
ground grid at the sea-surface height; no slant-plane Jacobian

bp.CRS_from_code: WGS84 UTM 10N (EPSG:32610 implied); bearing relative to grid north
bp.weighting_from_code: Uniform pulse sum; no taper or per-look normalization; IFFT plus Catmull-Rom; carrier +1

content.selection_scope: GEC used for geographic ROI localization only; no GEC spectrum is used for SICD wave metrics.
content.roi_shape_reason: Ocean ROIs use 1200 x 9600 SICD pixels (approximately 0.54 km square) after full-aperture SICD refinement to exclude land. Land control retains 1536 x 12288 pixels (approximately 0.69 km square) for robust registration.
content.doppler_decomposition_rule: For every selected range row, all 107800 SICD azimuth columns must be transformed before any ROI column crop.

offshore.description: Open water farther seaward; refined on full-aperture SICD intensity to exclude all coastline pixels.
